gloss: to nitpick; to be fussy about details

definitions.gloss: to nitpick; to be fussy about details; to split hairs
definitions.explanation: To point out or complain about small, trivial matters. Often used with a mildly negative nuance, implying that the person is being overly particular or pedantic about things that don't really matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{細|こま}かいことを{言|い}わないで。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{細|こま}かいことを{言|い}う⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われている→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
examples.english: He's always nitpicking, so people around him don't like him.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}かいことを{言|い}うようだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I don't mean to nitpick, but the date on the document is wrong.

notes:
A common set phrase built from ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ (detailed, fine) + こと (things) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say). The expression is used both to criticize someone for being overly particular and as a self-deprecating hedge when pointing something out oneself.

The hedge pattern {細|こま}かいことを{言|い}うようだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧... (I don't mean to nitpick, but...) is very common in workplace settings and polite conversation when one needs to raise a minor issue without seeming difficult.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {細|こま}かいことを{言|い}わないで: don't nitpick
- {細|こま}かいことを{言|い}うようだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: I don't mean to nitpick, but...
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧こと⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to always nitpick
- {細|こま}かいことを{言|い}い⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to start nitpicking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}うるさい→口うるさい：16036_kuchiurusai⟧: nagging; fussy — describes a person who habitually criticizes
- ⟦{重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつく→重箱の隅をつつく：15492_juubakonosumiwotsutsuku⟧: to poke at the corners of a stacked box — to nitpick obsessively (more emphatic)
- ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to fixate on trivial matters — neutral phrasing
